normal.name: Zumbador
normal.text: Visited a friend and played the game he created. It's an abstract strategy game, very cleverly designed and satisfying to play. The game is called "Intent" but unfortunately it's not available for sale. Can theoretically be played without any board or pieces, just by drawing on paper and using random objects as pieces. Edited to add: You can find the rules on the game designer's instagram account https://www.instagram.com/p/DQ7iFNWDUTT/?img_index=1 #gameDesign #games
